description: Find the inspection sheet that a gliding club's index lists but the folder does not hold. DISTILL-CANARY-93b2a5df

files.README.md:
Harelaw Gliding Club - daily inspections

An inspection sheet is filed for each day flying takes place, as soon as the
duty instructor has finished it. The index beside the sheets was typed from
the flying programme at the start of the month.

turns.prompt: Harelaw Gliding Club files one inspection sheet for every day flying takes place, and the index beside them lists the sheets the folder is meant to hold. One sheet the index names was never filed. Which one is missing? Give the sheet's reference alone, exactly as the index writes it, with nothing else. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
